verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ יוּעַ֣ם זָהָ֔ב יִשְׁנֶ֖א הַכֶּ֣תֶם הַטּ֑וֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֙כְנָה֙ אַבְנֵי־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּרֹ֖אשׁ כָּל־ חוּצֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh yū·‘am zā·hāḇ yiš·ne hak·ke·ṯem haṭ·ṭō·wḇ tiš·tap·pê·ḵə·nāh ’aḇ·nê- qō·ḏeš bə·rōš kāl- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: How the gold has become tarnished the pure gold has become dull The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner
verses.literalPt: COMO se escureceu o ouro! Como se mudou o ouro puro e bom! Como estão espalhadas as pedras do santuário sobre cada rua!

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י צִיּוֹן֙ הַיְקָרִ֔ים הַמְסֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּפָּ֑ז אֵיכָ֤ה נֶחְשְׁבוּ֙ לְנִבְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י יוֹצֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ṣî·yō·wn hay·qā·rîm ham·sul·lā·’îm bap·pāz ’ê·ḵāh neḥ·šə·ḇū lə·niḇ·lê- ḥe·reś ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê yō·w·ṣêr
verses.literal: How the precious sons of Zion once worth their weight in pure gold are now esteemed as jars of clay the work of a potter’s hands
verses.literalPt: Os preciosos filhos de Sião, avaliados a puro ouro, como são agora reputados por vasos de barro, obra das mãos do oleiro!

verses.original: גַּם־ תַּנִּין חָ֣לְצוּ שַׁ֔ד הֵינִ֖יקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶ֑ן בַּת־ עַמִּ֣י לְאַכְזָ֔ר כִּי עֵנִים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- tan·nīn ḥā·lə·ṣū šaḏ hê·nî·qū gū·rê·hen baṯ- ‘am·mî lə·’aḵ·zār kī ʿē·nīm bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young but the daughter of my people has become cruel like an ostrich in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Até os chacais abaixam o peito, dão de mamar aos seus filhos; mas a filha do meu povo tornou-se cruel como os avestruzes no deserto.

verses.original: דָּבַ֨ק לְשׁ֥וֹן יוֹנֵ֛ק אֶל־ חכּ֖וֹ בַּצָּמָ֑א עֽוֹלָלִים֙ שָׁ֣אֲלוּ לֶ֔חֶם פֹּרֵ֖שׂ אֵ֥ין לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: dā·ḇaq lə·šō·wn yō·w·nêq ’el- ḥ·kō baṣ·ṣā·mā ‘ō·w·lā·lîm šā·’ă·lū le·ḥem pō·rêś ’ên lā·hem
verses.literal: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth Little children beg for bread but no . . . one gives them any
verses.literalPt: A língua do que mama fica pegada pela sede ao seu paladar; os meninos pedem pão, e ninguém lho reparte.

verses.original: הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ לְמַ֣עֲדַנִּ֔ים נָשַׁ֖מּוּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת הָאֱמֻנִים֙ עֲלֵ֣י תוֹלָ֔ע חִבְּק֖וּ אַשְׁפַּתּֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm lə·ma·‘ă·ḏan·nîm nā·šam·mū ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ĕ·mu·nîm ‘ă·lê ṯō·w·lā‘ ḥib·bə·qū ’aš·pat·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps
verses.literalPt: Os que comiam comidas finas agora desfalecem nas ruas; os que se criaram em carmesim abraçam monturos.

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּל֙ עֲוֺ֣ן בַּת־ עַמִּ֔י מֵֽחַטַּ֖את סְדֹ֑ם הַֽהֲפוּכָ֣ה כְמוֹ־ רָ֔גַע וְלֹא־ חָ֥לוּ בָ֖הּ יָדָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·dal ‘ă·wōn baṯ- ‘am·mî mê·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ sə·ḏōm ha·hă·p̄ū·ḵāh ḵə·mōw- rā·ḡa‘ wə·lō- ḥā·lū ḇāh yā·ḏā·yim
verses.literal: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her
verses.literalPt: Porque maior é a iniqüidade da filha do meu povo do que o pecado de Sodoma, a qual foi subvertida como num momento, sem que mãos lhe tocassem.

verses.original: זַכּ֤וּ נְזִירֶ֙יהָ֙ מִשֶּׁ֔לֶג צַח֖וּ מֵחָלָ֑ב אָ֤דְמוּ עֶ֙צֶם֙ מִפְּנִינִ֔ים סַפִּ֖יר גִּזְרָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: zak·kū nə·zî·re·hā miš·še·leḡ ṣa·ḥū mê·ḥā·lāḇ ’ā·ḏə·mū ‘e·ṣem mip·pə·nî·nîm sap·pîr giz·rā·ṯām
verses.literal: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow whiter than milk their bodies were more ruddy than rubies their appearance like sapphires
verses.literalPt: Os seus nobres eram mais puros do que a neve, mais brancos do que o leite, mais vermelhos de corpo do que os rubis, e mais polidos do que a safira.

verses.original: חָשַׁ֤ךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר֙ תָּֽאֳרָ֔ם לֹ֥א נִכְּר֖וּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת צָפַ֤ד עוֹרָם֙ עַל־ עַצְמָ֔ם יָבֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֥ה כָעֵֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·šaḵ miš·šə·ḥō·wr tā·’o·rām lō nik·kə·rū ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ṣā·p̄aḏ ‘ō·w·rām ‘al- ‘aṣ·mām yā·ḇêš hā·yāh ḵā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: But now their appearance is blacker than soot they are not recognized in the streets Their skin has shriveled on their bones it has become as dry as a stick
verses.literalPt: Mas agora escureceu-se o seu aspecto mais do que o negrume; não são conhecidos nas ruas; a sua pele se lhes pegou aos ossos, secou-se, tornou-se como um pau.

verses.original: טוֹבִ֤ים הָיוּ֙ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב מֵֽחַלְלֵ֖י רָעָ֑ב שֶׁ֣הֵ֤ם יָז֙וּבוּ֙ מְדֻקָּרִ֔ים מִתְּנוּבֹ֖ת שָׂדָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṭō·w·ḇîm hā·yū ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ mê·ḥal·lê rā·‘āḇ še·hêm yā·zū·ḇū mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm mit·tə·nū·ḇōṯ śā·ḏāy
verses.literal: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger who waste away pierced with pain because the fields lack produce
verses.literalPt: Os mortos à espada foram mais ditosos do que os mortos à fome; porque estes morreram lentamente, por falta dos frutos dos campos.

verses.original: יְדֵ֗י נָשִׁים֙ רַחֲמָ֣נִיּ֔וֹת בִּשְּׁל֖וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן הָי֤וּ לְבָרוֹת֙ לָ֔מוֹ בְּשֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏê nā·šîm ra·ḥă·mā·nî·yō·wṯ biš·šə·lū yal·ḏê·hen hā·yū lə·ḇā·rō·wṯ lā·mōw bə·še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people
verses.literalPt: As mãos das mulheres compassivas cozeram seus próprios filhos; serviram-lhes de alimento na destruição da filha do meu povo.

verses.original: כִּלָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ חֲמָת֔וֹ שָׁפַ֖ךְ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּצֶּת־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וַתֹּ֖אכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kil·lāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- ḥă·mā·ṯōw šā·p̄aḵ ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw way·yaṣ·ṣeṯ- ’êš bə·ṣî·yō·wn wat·tō·ḵal yə·sō·w·ḏō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: The LORD has exhausted His wrath He has poured out His fierce anger He has kindled a fire in Zion and it has consumed her foundations
verses.literalPt: Deu o SENHOR cumprimento ao seu furor; derramou o ardor da sua ira, e acendeu fogo em Sião, que consumiu os seus fundamentos.

verses.original: לֹ֤א הֶאֱמִ֙ינוּ֙ מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֔רֶץ וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵבֵ֑ל כִּ֤י יָבֹא֙ צַ֣ר וְאוֹיֵ֔ב בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō he·’ĕ·mî·nū mal·ḵê- ’e·reṣ wə·ḵå̄l yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl kî yā·ḇō ṣar wə·’ō·w·yêḇ bə·ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: The kings of the earth did not believe nor any people of the world that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Não creram os reis da terra, nem todos os moradores do mundo, que entrasse o adversário e o inimigo pelas portas de Jerusalém.

verses.original: מֵֽחַטֹּ֣את נְבִיאֶ֔יהָ עֲוֺנ֖וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֑יהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִ֥ים בְּקִרְבָּ֖הּ דַּ֥ם צַדִּיקִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mê·ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ nə·ḇî·’e·hā ‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ kō·hă·ne·hā haš·šō·p̄ə·ḵîm bə·qir·bāh dam ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst
verses.literalPt: Foi por causa dos pecados dos profetas, das maldades dos seus sacerdotes, que derramaram o sangue dos justos no meio dela.

verses.original: נָע֤וּ עִוְרִים֙ בַּֽחוּצ֔וֹת נְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ בַּדָּ֑ם בְּלֹ֣א יֽוּכְל֔וּ יִגְּע֖וּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: nā·‘ū ‘iw·rîm ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ nə·ḡō·’ă·lū bad·dām bə·lō yū·ḵə·lū yig·gə·‘ū bil·ḇu·šê·hem
verses.literal: They wandered blind in the streets defiled by this blood so that no one dared to touch their garments
verses.literalPt: Vagueiam como cegos nas ruas, andam contaminados de sangue; de tal sorte que ninguém pode tocar nas suas roupas.

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ טָמֵ֞א קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֗מוֹ ס֤וּרוּ ס֙וּרוּ֙ אַל־ תִּגָּ֔עוּ כִּ֥י נָצ֖וּ גַּם־ נָ֑עוּ אָֽמְרוּ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יפוּ לָגֽוּר׃ס
verses.transliteration: sū·rū ṭā·mê qā·rə·’ū lā·mōw sū·rū sū·rū ’al- tig·gā·‘ū kî nā·ṣū gam- nā·‘ū ’ā·mə·rū bag·gō·w·yim lō yō·w·sî·p̄ū lā·ḡūr
verses.literal: Go away Unclean men shouted at them Away away Do not touch us So they fled and wandered Among the nations it was said They can stay here no longer
verses.literalPt: Desviai-vos, imundos! gritavam-lhes; desviai-vos, desviai-vos, não toqueis! quando fugiram e também andaram errantes, dizia-se entre os gentios: Nunca mais morarão aqui.

verses.original: פְּנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ חִלְּקָ֔ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַבִּיטָ֑ם פְּנֵ֤י כֹהֲנִים֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔אוּ זְקֵנִים לֹ֥א חָנָֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: pə·nê Yah·weh ḥil·lə·qām lō yō·w·sîp̄ lə·hab·bî·ṭām pə·nê ḵō·hă·nîm lō nā·śā·’ū zə·qē·nīm lō ḥā·nā·nū
verses.literal: The presence of the LORD has scattered them He regards them no more The priests are shown no honor the elders find no favor
verses.literalPt: A face indignada do SENHOR os espalhou, ele nunca mais tornará a olhar para eles; não respeitaram a pessoa dos sacerdotes, nem se compadeceram dos velhos.

verses.original: עוֹדֵינָה תִּכְלֶ֣ינָה עֵינֵ֔ינוּ אֶל־ עֶזְרָתֵ֖נוּ הָ֑בֶל בְּצִפִּיָּתֵ֣נוּ צִפִּ֔ינוּ אֶל־ גּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ʿō·ḏē·nå̄h tiḵ·le·nāh ‘ê·nê·nū ’el- ‘ez·rā·ṯê·nū hā·ḇel bə·ṣip·pî·yā·ṯê·nū ṣip·pî·nū ’el- gō·w lō yō·wō·ši·a‘
verses.literal: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us
verses.literalPt: Os nossos olhos desfaleciam, esperando o nosso vão socorro; olhávamos atentamente para uma nação que não nos podia livrar.

verses.original: צָד֣וּ צְעָדֵ֔ינוּ מִלֶּ֖כֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵ֑ינוּ קָרַ֥ב קִצֵּ֛ינוּ מָלְא֥וּ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כִּי־ בָ֥א קִצֵּֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣā·ḏū ṣə·‘ā·ḏê·nū mil·le·ḵeṯ bir·ḥō·ḇō·ṯê·nū qā·raḇ qiṣ·ṣê·nū mā·lə·’ū yā·mê·nū kî- ḇā qiṣ·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: They stalked our every step so that we could not walk in our streets Our end drew near our time . . . ran out for our end had come
verses.literalPt: Espiaram os nossos passos, de maneira que não podíamos andar pelas nossas ruas; está chegado o nosso fim, estão cumpridos os nossos dias, porque é vindo o nosso fim.

verses.original: קַלִּ֤ים הָיוּ֙ רֹדְפֵ֔ינוּ מִנִּשְׁרֵ֖י שָׁמָ֑יִם עַל־ הֶהָרִ֣ים דְּלָקֻ֔נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר אָ֥רְבוּ לָֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: qal·lîm hā·yū rō·ḏə·p̄ê·nū min·niš·rê šā·mā·yim ‘al- he·hā·rîm də·lā·qu·nū bam·miḏ·bār ’ā·rə·ḇū lā·nū
verses.literal: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Os nossos perseguidores foram mais ligeiros do que as águias dos céus; sobre os montes nos perseguiram, no deserto nos armaram ciladas.

verses.original: ר֤וּחַ אַפֵּ֙ינוּ֙ מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה נִלְכַּ֖ד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְנוּ בְּצִלּ֖וֹ נִֽחְיֶ֥ה בַגּוֹיִֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ ’ap·pê·nū mə·šî·aḥ Yah·weh nil·kaḏ biš·ḥî·ṯō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·nū bə·ṣil·lōw niḥ·yeh ḇag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: The LORD’s anointed the breath of our life was captured in their pits We had said of him Under his shadow we will live among the nations
verses.literalPt: O fôlego das nossas narinas, o ungido do SENHOR, foi preso nas suas covas; dele dizíamos: Debaixo da sua sombra viveremos entre os gentios.

verses.original: שִׂ֤ישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי֙ בַּת־ אֱד֔וֹם יוֹשַׁבְתִּי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ע֑וּץ גַּם־ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ תַּעֲבָר־ כּ֔וֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִ֖י וְתִתְעָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: śî·śî wə·śim·ḥî baṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm yō·šaḇ·tī bə·’e·reṣ ‘ūṣ gam- ‘ā·la·yiḵ ta·‘ă·ḇār- kō·ws tiš·kə·rî wə·ṯiṯ·‘ā·rî
verses.literal: So rejoice and be glad O Daughter of Edom you who dwell in the land of Uz Yet the cup will pass to you as well you will get drunk and expose yourself
verses.literalPt: Regozija-te e alegra-te, ó filha de Edom, que habitas na terra de Uz; o cálice passará também para ti; embebedar-te-ás, e te descobrirás.

verses.original: תַּם־ עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַגְלוֹתֵ֑ךְ פָּקַ֤ד עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־ אֱד֔וֹם גִּלָּ֖ה עַל־ חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: tam- ‘ă·wō·nêḵ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn lō yō·w·sîp̄ lə·haḡ·lō·w·ṯêḵ pā·qaḏ ‘ă·wō·nêḵ baṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm gil·lāh ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: O Daughter of Zion your punishment is complete He will not prolong your exile But He will punish your iniquity O Daughter of Edom He will expose . . . your sins
verses.literalPt: O castigo da tua maldade está consumado, ó filha de Sião; ele nunca mais te levará para o cativeiro; ele visitará a tua maldade, ó filha de Edom, descobrirá os teus pecados.
